payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about various baseline models used in speech translation experiments, including their configurations and performance comparisons.

claims.text: The baselines include a vanilla ST model, pre-training baselines (encoder, decoder, and encoder-decoder pre-training), and multi-task baselines (one-to-many, many-to-one, and many-to-many settings).
The pre-training baselines utilize ASR and MT models to initialize the encoder and decoder, respectively, enhancing performance compared to the vanilla model.
Multi-task baselines are designed to improve translation quality by training models with different weight settings for speech translation, ASR, and MT tasks.
